_readme: Hard gates are enforced deterministically in code (lib/gates.mjs).
Evidence anchors feed the radar-scorer subagent, which may only award fit
points by quoting the job description. Update this file when the resumes change.
Retuned 2026-07 after 39 applications produced zero interviews: targeting is
winnable-first. Senior/Strategic/Enterprise titles are excluded, roles requiring
6+ years are auto-C and 4-5 years capped B, location is remote-or-DFW only with
no comp exception, and the Marketing track is a backup capped at Tier B.

candidate.name: Chase Vandiver
candidate.positioning: Built and owned a partner sponsorship revenue program from zero to $300K recurring annual revenue. Qualified buyer-to-seller pivot, wants to carry a quota full time.

maxRequiredYears.rule: JDs demanding 4-5 years of sales experience are flagged and capped at Tier B; 6+ years is an automatic C. Chase is making a buyer-to-seller pivot with 0 formal quota-carrying years, so heavy YOE screens are unwinnable at resume stage.

evidenceAnchors: Built a supplier-partner sponsorship program from zero to $300K in recurring annual revenue
Full cycle: prospected new partners, pitched tailored packages, closed agreements, renewed year over year
Single point of contact from first outreach through contract and renewal (account management)
Reported performance, pipeline, and recommendations directly to the CEO (executive presence)
Contract negotiation and consultative selling with supplier partners
CRM: HubSpot. Also Cvent, Google Analytics, Mailchimp, Asana
Ran annual conference for 400+ attendees end to end (event and sponsor operations)
8 years generating revenue in self-directed, solo-owner roles

Marketing.maxTierRule: Backup track only. Marketing roles are always flagged and capped at Tier B so they never compete with the sales pivot for A-tier attention.
evidenceAnchors: Ran the entire marketing department solo, reporting directly to the CEO
Built a sponsorship program from scratch that brought in $300K annually
Website overhaul and SEO push grew organic traffic 25% in year one
Annual conference: 400+ attendees, vendors, keynote coordination, full logistics
Integrated email, social, digital campaigns lifted engagement 15% YoY
Social media engagement up 35% in first year via content and cadence rework
Email open rates up 15% through subject line testing and segmentation
Owned Marketing and Events budget; HubSpot, Mailchimp, GA, Cvent, Asana, Adobe CC

location.outOfAreaRule: Out-of-area roles are excluded, period. A role passes location only if it is explicitly remote-eligible or in a DFW city. No comp-based exception. Enforced in code.

freshness.missingDateRule: If the ATS provides no posted date, the row is flagged 'date unverified' and capped at Tier B. Never guess a date.

compRules.missingCompRule: If no comp is stated by the API or the job description, comp stays blank, the row is flagged 'comp unverified' and capped at Tier B. Never estimate comp.
compRules.belowFloorRule: Stated comp below the track floor is an automatic C. Deterministic, computed in code.
